task: UIUX-2026 issue #298 — dialogs, bottom sheets and dangerous actions

checks.name: Web dialog, safety, accessibility and viewport browser suite
checks.command: cd clients/web && CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH='/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome' ./node_modules/.bin/playwright test -c tests/accessibility/playwright.config.ts tests/accessibility/admin_confirmation.browser.spec.ts
observations: Axe confirms no critical dialog accessibility violations; safe Cancel is focused first, Escape cancels, focus wraps and returns to the trigger.
Create category/channel forms pass duplicate-submit checks and preserve their draft and announced response across 403, 409 and 503 before a successful retry.
A stale topology target, removed voice target or changed account closes confirmation without sending a mutation.
Screen-share controls remain reachable at 393x852, 320x640, 844x390 landscape and 390x844 with 2x root text.

checks.name: Flutter confirmation, target validation, screen setup and visual capture widgets
checks.command: cd clients/flutter && flutter test --no-pub test/confirmation_dialog_test.dart test/topology_confirmed_target_test.dart test/screen_setup/dialog_test.dart test/uiux_2026/dialog_visual_capture_test.dart
observations: Cancel-first Enter, modal barrier, closed traversal, Escape/Back, trigger focus restoration, account scope and destructive target/revision rules pass.
Create retains its draft across 403/409/503, ignores a duplicate while pending and closes on successful retry.
The simulated mobile IME matrix covers compact, medium and expanded viewports with 1x/2x text; landscape and screen-reader labels are also asserted.
The visual capture test passed with BOOHTACORD_VISUAL_CAPTURE_DIR set and produced three current widget screenshots.

checks.name: Cross-browser destructive-confirm dialog focus and keyboard traversal
checks.command: Playwright accessibility suite with Chromium 154, WebKit 26.6 and Firefox 155
observations: WebKit exposed that pointer activation may leave document.activeElement on body; confirmation now remembers the recently clicked opener and restores it with preventScroll.
Modal Tab handling now advances through every focusable control itself, so browser-level button tab-order preferences cannot skip the destructive action.
The safe Cancel action receives initial focus, Escape cancels and both Enter-cancel and Escape return focus to the initiating control.

The explicit Tab cycle preserves native radio-group semantics: Tab leaves the selected radio for the next control, while Shift+Tab returns to the selected option; visible summary controls are included.
limitations: No physical touch, VoiceOver, TalkBack, NVDA or Narrator acceptance was run.

checks.name: Short desktop screen-share regression and retained review capture

observations: The short desktop height rule keeps the dialog within the viewport and the body independently scrollable.
Both Cancel and Start screen share actions remain 99% visible without scrolling the page.
No CI workflow ran for the [skip ci] checkpoint.
